explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/556: 'Luczak [Lu99] has shown that R_3(C_n) ≤ (4+o(1))n for all n'. The Lean statement says for every ε > 0, for all sufficiently large n, multicolourRamsey (cycleGraph n) 3 ≤ (4+ε)·n, which is exactly the (4+o(1))n bound; `multicolourRamsey G 3` is the least N such that every 3-colouring (edge partition) of the complete graph on N vertices has a monochromatic copy of G. Faithful.
